intro: Martial arts rooms have their own clothes. Judo students wear a thick jacket. Sumo wrestlers wear a wide belt. School wrestlers in Illinois wear a one-piece suit.
In this unit, you will learn what a belt shows. You will learn that a belt is a mark of rank, not magic. You will also learn the names of many arts and the places they come from.
By the end, you can name a uniform and tell which art wears it. You can tell karate from taekwondo. You can find Okinawa, Korea, China, Thailand, Brazil and Europe in each name.
bigQuestion: What can clothes and names tell us about where a martial art comes from?

timeline.t: Japan takes over the Ryukyu kingdom on Okinawa
Kanō Jigorō starts judo in Tokyo
Fencing is in the first modern Olympics
The world fencing group, the FIE, begins in Paris
Illinois has its first boys state wrestling champions
The name taekwondo is chosen in Korea
Judo joins the Olympics in Tokyo
Taekwondo is an Olympic medal sport in Sydney
Karate is in the Olympic Games in Tokyo
Illinois holds its first girls state wrestling finals

words.d: the thick cotton jacket and pants worn for judo
a step or level in a school
a top rank; people with a dan rank often wear a black belt
the wide belt a sumo wrestler wears
a tight one-piece suit worn for wrestling
an old kingdom on Okinawa and nearby islands
the Korean word for a room where taekwondo is practiced
a wide English word for many Chinese martial arts

test.why: A belt is a mark of rank that a school gives.
Karate grew on Okinawa, once the Ryukyu kingdom.
A singlet is a one-piece suit for wrestling.

test.q: When was the name taekwondo chosen?
test.why: The name taekwondo was chosen in Korea in 1955.

test.q: What is the top rank in sumo?
test.why: Yokozuna is the top rank in sumo.
Muay means boxing, so Muay Thai means Thai boxing.

test.q: Which word is a wide English word for many Chinese arts?
test.why: Kung fu is a wide English word for many Chinese martial arts.

test.q: When did Illinois girls have their first state wrestling finals?
test.why: The IHSA held the first girls wrestling state finals in 2022.

test.q: Where did Kanō Jigorō start judo?
test.why: Kanō Jigorō started judo in Tokyo in 1882.

write.prompt: Pick two martial arts from this unit. Tell where each one comes from and what its students wear. Use at least two dates or records from the unit, such as 1882 for judo or 1955 for taekwondo. Tell one way the two arts are the same and one way they are different.
tips: Name the place each art comes from.
Use one date for each art.
Use words from the unit, like judogi, dobok or singlet.
Tell what a belt or uniform shows, not what it does.
